name: Boom Chaka Laka | 1.3g Live Resin Tarantula | Sex On The Beach
description: Sweet, smooth, and just the right kind of wild — the Sex on the Beach Hybrid Tarantula is your all-access pass to vacation-mode. Packed with top-shelf hybrid flower, soaked in tropical live resin, and rolled in a potent layer of kief, this pre-roll hits like a beachside breeze with cheeky kick. Expect juicy waves of peach, citrus, and cranberry flavors, paired with a perfectly balanced high that keeps you lifted and laid-back. It's the perfect getaway, no plane ticket needed.
